newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends easier vs dlr at 189.04/09.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends easier vs dlr at 189.04/09.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed easier against the dollar after range trading on Friday, dealers said.
The forint closed at 189.04/09 against the U.S. unit compared with an opening of 188.93/98.
"The forint moved in a narrow range as did the dollar/mark," said Orsolya Liptai of ABN AMRO Magyar Hitel Bank.
The Hungarian unit remained right on the National Bank of Hungary resistance level (bid) throughout the session.
The Hungarian unit floats against the central bank's currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide.
